long_description: Inspect a public website you own, administer, or have permission to review. Evercraft returns bounded, evidence-backed HTTP and on-page signals with explicit limitations. It does not modify the site, access private networks, create payments, or perform other consequential actions.
release_notes: Evercraft v1.1.0 exposes a purpose-specific OpenAI MCP with one standalone authorized public-website inspection tool. The full internal Fabric directory is not exposed through the submitted endpoint.
starter_prompts: Inspect my public website and show me the basic signals that need attention.
Check my website for missing title, description, headings, canonical, and contact signals.
Inspect my homepage for basic on-page and conversion signals.
remaining_platform_prerequisites: Do not cancel or replace the active Evercraft v1.0.0 review until v1.1.0 is fully proven or the provider review resolves
After the active v1.0.0 review resolves or is deliberately cancelled, deploy the staged /mcp/openai profile and capture a fresh passing external canary for that exact endpoint
Re-run the current OpenAI MCP Scan Tools check against the restored production endpoint
Refresh the reviewer walkthrough to demonstrate inspect_public_website on the purpose-specific OpenAI endpoint
Upload the canonical Evercraft v1.1.0 ZIP in OpenAI Platform Plugins
Select the verified Evercraft LLC developer identity in the owning organization/project
Confirm Apps Management Write access if the submitter is not an organization owner
Complete the portal-generated domain verification challenge for fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com
Confirm the imported five positive and three negative tests plus reviewer walkthrough
Independent directory discovery receipt after publication

inspect_public_website.readOnlyHint: True because the tool only retrieves and analyzes one user-authorized public HTTP/HTTPS website and does not modify the target or create Evercraft records, jobs, payments, messages, or external side effects.
inspect_public_website.destructiveHint: False because the tool cannot delete, overwrite, publish, purchase, deploy, authenticate to, or mutate the inspected website or another external system.
inspect_public_website.openWorldHint: True because the tool accesses a user-authorized public internet URL. Private/local/reserved addresses, embedded credentials, nonstandard ports, unsafe redirects, oversized responses, and unsupported content types are rejected.
